learnings: Observation lives in @arxhub/vfs: `VfsWatcher` (subscribe/notify + optional onError), `VfsChange {kind: 'written'|'deleted'|'renamed', pathname, from?}`, `VfsChangeSource` (the read-only face the DI key hands out), `INFO_FILE_SUFFIX`, `ObservedFileSystem`, and the `VaultWatcher` key in vfs-scope.ts. Construct the decorator with `ObservedFileSystem.wrap(inner, watcher)`, never `new`: rename is a per-backend capability that isRenameCapable() detects by looking for the method, so wrap() returns a private rename-capable subclass only over a backend that renames natively. In production the vault view is ObservedFileSystem over ScopedFileSystem, and ScopedFileSystem has NO rename — so an explorer rename really arrives as written(new) + deleted(old), which the queue handles correctly. Paths reach subscribers vault-relative (the decorator sits OUTSIDE the scope), which is exactly the coordinate system the index stores. VfsPlugin.setup() creates one watcher, binds it to VaultWatcher and wraps only VaultVfs; RootVfs and the per-plugin buckets stay unwrapped. plugins/search/src/index-queue.ts is the debounce: two Sets (toIndex/toRemove), timer restarted on every change, single in-flight drain exposed as `queue.running` so stop() awaits it before the index closes. A listener runs synchronously inside the operation that notified it (often under that path's lock), so it may only record and return — VfsWatcher catches a throwing listener so it can never fail a write that already succeeded. KNOWN GAP: a directory rename/delete reports one change on the directory path, and removePath() on a directory removes no document rows, so stale rows under it survive until the next full scan. Fixing it needs a delete-by-prefix in the engine (packages/sql), which a concurrent worker owned during this task.

Новый тест разобран по каждому заявленному свойству и подтверждён по коду: отрицательная проверка перед вводом слова делает поздний хит необъяснимым недоработавшим обходом, сохранение доказано чтением файла с диска, между сохранением и поиском нет ни одной навигации, удаление идёт через дерево приложения, контрольная заметка отличает «удалилось» от «поиск сломался», имена файлов разведены по рамам. Отдельно верификатор построил стенд из 15 проверок над настоящей цепочкой NodeFileSystem → ScopedFileSystem(vault) → ObservedFileSystem/VfsWatcher → IndexQueue → Indexer и прогнал КОНТРОЛЬНЫЙ опыт: без подписки на VaultWatcher та же запись не подхватывается — то есть причина прохождения именно проводка.
